risk_unit_r: entry-frozen |fill - band/VWAP stop reference at entry|, per stop_ref both
ladder_levels_source: paper 5095349 Table 2 illustrative example, NOT the Table 11 in-sample-optimized values
cost_convention: one round-trip charged per trade row; the 50% partial's extra half-turn commission is not separately modeled (matches the existing tp1.0_50 convention; slightly favours the ladder)
primary_metric: zero-trade-day daily net-ATR-R Sharpe uplift of the ladder over the both stop
kill_test: reject if ladder Sharpe uplift over both < 0.10, ladder net R < both net R, or Null C upper-tail p > 0.05; weaken if ladder Sharpe < tp1.0_50 or sign does not transfer to ES
